name: J.A.R.V.I.S bot
greeting: Hi, I answer common questions about Sujel's work. Pick one below or type your own.
fallback: I don't have an answer for that yet. Try one of these, or reach Sujel directly.

items.a: Md Mahfujur Rahman Sujel is a software engineering student who builds web and Android products end to end: interface, front end, API and database.
He is doing a BSc in Computer Science and Engineering at East West University, Bangladesh.
Mostly React and TypeScript on the front end, Spring Boot on the back end, and Kotlin for Android. The full list is in the Stack section.
Three main projects: Apex Arcade (a browser game hub), Unrot (an Android app) and Oppzy (a team project). Each has its own card under Selected work.
A React and TypeScript launcher for 50 browser games, built with Vite and installable as a PWA.
Unrot is an Android app he built with Kotlin. See its card under Selected work for details and the repository link.
A team project: an internship and research matching platform. It lives under a collaborator's account, so it appears in the repository index.
The best way is LinkedIn. GitHub works too for anything about the code.
github.com/md-mahfujur-rahman-sujel. The Repositories section lists the public ones.
It is a snapshot refreshed by a GitHub Action about every three hours, so it is recent but not instant.
SUJEL.OS is the name of this portfolio, styled like a small operating system. Ironbot is the flying mascot; you can switch it off with the toggle in the menu bar.

items.q: How do I jump around the site?
items.a: Press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on Mac) to open the command palette and jump to any section or project.
